title: Restaurant General Manager
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION - RESTAURANT GENERAL MANAGER (RGM) 
 Position: Restaurant General Manager (RGM) 
 Department: Operations 
 
 1. Position Summary 
The Restaurant General Manager (RGM) will be responsible for the overall management and performance of the assigned at restaurant.
The role will drive sales, profitability, customer experience, operational excellence, people management, training & development, food quality, inventory control, compliance and team capability building .
The RGM will act as the overall business owner of the restaurant , ensuring that the outlet operates efficiently while consistently delivering Maiz brand, food, service and operational standards.
 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 2.1 Restaurant Operations 
 Manage the complete day-to-day operations of the restaurant. Ensure smooth opening, operating and closing procedures. Maintain operational standards as per company SOPs. Ensure optimum deployment of manpower across all shifts. Monitor service speed, order accuracy and restaurant readiness. Ensure all operational checklists are completed accurately and on time. Ensure consistent execution of company processes and brand standards. Identify operational gaps and implement corrective action plans. 
 2.2 Sales & Business Performance 
 Drive restaurant sales and achieve monthly and annual business targets. Monitor daily sales, average transaction value, customer count, order count and other business KPIs. Analyze sales trends and identify opportunities for business growth. Drive local store marketing and promotional initiatives in coordination with the Operations and Marketing teams. Identify opportunities to improve customer footfall, repeat business and sales. Develop and execute action plans for underperforming business areas. Ensure effective execution of campaigns, offers and new product launches at the restaurant. 
 
 
 2.3 Cost & Profitability Management 
 Manage restaurant controllable costs and ensure profitability. Monitor food cost, packaging cost, labour cost and other operating expenses. Control food wastage, pilferage and unnecessary expenses. Review daily and weekly cost reports and take corrective action. Ensure compliance with approved budgets and cost-control guidelines. Monitor restaurant contribution/EBITDA and identify opportunities for improvement. Maintain appropriate balance between customer service, operational efficiency and cost control. 
 2.4 People Management 
 Lead, motivate and develop the complete restaurant team. Ensure adequate manpower availability for all shifts. Participate in recruitment, selection and onboarding of restaurant employees. Conduct regular team briefings and performance reviews. Set clear performance expectations for team members. Identify high-potential employees and support their career development. Ensure effective deployment, cross-training and utilization of employees. Manage attendance, discipline and employee engagement. Create a positive, inclusive and performance-driven work environment. Address employee concerns appropriately and escalate matters to HR wherever required. Build strong employee engagement and retention within the restaurant. 
 2.5 Customer Experience 
 Ensure every customer receives a consistent and positive dining experience. Monitor customer feedback, complaints and service recovery. Resolve customer complaints promptly and professionally. Track online ratings and reviews and identify recurring service issues. Ensure service standards are consistently maintained. Monitor order accuracy, service time, food presentation and overall customer experience. Coach employees on customer service and service recovery standards. 
 2.6 Food Quality & Safety 
 Ensure strict adherence to food preparation, quality and food safety standards. Maintain product quality, portion control, taste and presentation standards. Ensure proper temperature control, storage and handling of food. Conduct regular hygiene and food safety checks. Ensure all food safety and statutory requirements are followed. Ensure proper cleaning and sanitation practices. Take immediate corrective action for any food safety or quality deviation. Ensure all employees follow prescribed food safety and hygiene practices. 
 2.7 Inventory & Stock Management 
 Manage daily inventory and ensure adequate stock availability. Ensure appropriate stock levels for uninterrupted restaurant operations. Monitor food, packaging and consumable inventory. Control wastage, expiry and stock variance. Conduct regular stock counts and reconciliation. Investigate and resolve inventory variances. Ensure FIFO/FEFO practices are followed wherever applicable. Monitor ordering and consumption patterns to optimize inventory levels. Ensure proper storage and handling of all inventories. 
 2.8 Cash & Financial Controls 
 Ensure proper cash handling and reconciliation procedures. Monitor cash collections and POS transactions. Ensure cash variance remains within approved company limits. Ensure proper documentation of refunds, discounts and void transactions. Monitor financial controls and prevent revenue leakage. Escalate financial irregularities immediately. Ensure compliance with all cash-handling and financial control procedures. 
 2.9 Training & Capability Building 
 Ensure all employees complete mandatory induction and operational training. Conduct regular on-the-job training and refresher sessions. Develop Shift Managers and other potential leaders. Maintain training records and ensure completion of mandatory modules. Ensure employees are trained on restaurant SOPs, product knowledge, food safety, customer service, POS, inventory, cash handling and workplace safety. Conduct regular coaching and on-the-job skill development. Identify individual and team-level training gaps. Ensure training gaps identified through audits, customer complaints, performance reviews or operational deviations are addressed. Build a strong internal talent pipeline for future restaurant leadership positions. 
 2.10 Training, Development & Talent Management 
 Take ownership of the training, development and capability building of the complete restaurant team. Prepare and execute a monthly training calendar in coordination with HR/Training & Development. Conduct regular On-the-Job Training (OJT) for Crew Members, Team Members, Shift Managers and other employees. Identify training needs based on performance, skill gaps, audits, customer feedback and operational observations. Ensure all new joiners complete prescribed induction, onboarding and role-specific training within defined timelines. Conduct refresher training to maintain operational and service standards. Maintain accurate training records, skill matrices and competency assessments . Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, observation and performance results. Identify High Potential (HiPo) employees and create individual development plans. Develop Shift Managers and Assistant Managers through coaching, mentoring and increased business responsibilities. Build a strong internal pipeline for future Shift Manager, Assistant Manager and RGM positions. Support employees in career development, IJP, promotion and succession planning opportunities. Ensure employees promoted to higher roles receive appropriate role-readiness and transition training. Conduct regular performance and development discussions with team members. Provide constructive feedback and create development plans wherever required. Work closely with HR and Learning & Development teams to implement company training initiatives. Promote a continuous learning and development culture within the restaurant. Maintain a ready talent pipeline for critical restaurant leadership positions. 
 Training & Development KPIs 
 New Joiner Training Completion % Mandatory Training Completion % Training Hours per Employee OJT Completion % Skill Matrix Completion % Training Effectiveness % Assessment/Certification Pass % Internal Promotion % Internal Hiring/Movement % HiPo Identification & Development Leadership Pipeline Readiness Training Gap Closure % New Joiner 30/60/90-Day Performance Reduction in Operational Errors through Training 
 
 
 2.11 Compliance & Audit 
 Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs and statutory requirements. Maintain all restaurant licenses, records and mandatory documentation. Ensure compliance with food safety, labour, fire and workplace safety requirements. Prepare the restaurant for internal and external audits. Ensure all audit requirements are completed within defined timelines. Close audit observations within agreed timelines. Maintain proper documentation and records for all compliance requirements. Immediately report critical compliance or safety concerns to the appropriate management team. 
 2.12 Maintenance & Restaurant Upkeep 
 Ensure restaurant cleanliness, hygiene and overall appearance. Monitor equipment condition and coordinate preventive maintenance. Report equipment breakdowns and maintenance requirements promptly. Ensure timely closure of maintenance-related issues. Ensure the restaurant is always guest-ready, clean and operationally safe. Monitor facilities, furniture, fixtures and restaurant assets. Prevent unnecessary damage and ensure proper utilization of company assets. 
 2.13 Reporting & MIS 
 Review daily restaurant performance reports. Submit required operational and business MIS within defined timelines. Track key restaurant KPIs and prepare action plans for gaps. Analyze sales, cost, manpower, inventory and customer performance. Conduct regular performance reviews with the Area Manager / Regional Operations Manager. Maintain accurate records and ensure timely reporting of critical business information. Use data and business insights to improve restaurant performance. 
 3. Key Performance Indicators, KPIs 
Business & Sales, Cost & Profitability, Operations, Customer, People, Training & Development
 
 4. Candidate Profile 
 Education 
 10 +2 (With Relevant work experience of 3 years) Graduate in any discipline. Degree/Diploma in Hotel Management or Hospitality Management will be preferred. 
 
 Experience 
 5 - 8 years of experience in restaurant/QSR operations, with at least 2-3 years in a manager-level role. Experience in high-volume QSR or fast-casual restaurant operations preferred. Experience managing a team of 15- 30+ employees will be an advantage. Experience in sales, cost management, inventory control and people development is preferred. 
 5. Required Skills 
 Strong restaurant operations knowledge. Sales and business acumen. People and team management. Training and coaching capability. Cost and inventory control. Customer service orientation. Food safety and hygiene knowledge. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Problem-solving and decision-making ability. Good understanding of Excel, POS and restaurant management systems. Ability to analyze business data and identify improvement opportunities. Ability to work in a fast-paced and target-driven environment. 
 7. Role Expectation 
The RGM is expected to operate the restaurant as a business owner , balancing sales, profitability, people, customer experience, food quality, operational standards and compliance .
The RGM is also responsible for building the next generation of restaurant leaders by identifying, coaching and developing employees and maintaining a strong internal talent pipeline. 
 The RGM's core objective - Run a profitable, compliant and customer-focused restaurant while building a high-performing team and developing future restaurant leaders.

Key Skills: Restaurant Management,Food Costing,Inventory Control,Food and Beverage,Training and Development,Hotel Operations,Process Control,Wastage Control

Job Category Customer Success Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. The world of work as we know it is changing and were looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforces core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era You re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. Success Architect 
 
 Role Description 
 
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success. 
Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customers first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational Guide sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long-term success.
 
 Key Responsibilities
As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will: Drive Customer Impact - Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect). Lead with Expertise - Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices. Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor. Innovate Solve Problems - Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects. Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth. 
 Basic Requirements 
Solution Design Architecture 8+ years of hands-on technical experience (e.g., Senior Support Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Senior Salesforce Admin). Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices. Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles. Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices. Familiarity with industry- or vertical-specific solutions (preferred). Communication Leadership Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences. Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders. Proven ability to manage customer-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly. High proficiency in English. Strategic Thinking Problem Solving Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation. Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends. Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies. Desired Technical Skills Sales Cloud Expertise Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management. Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs. Data Management Integration Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third-party connectors. Secure Scalable Architecture Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations. Ability to review a customers security model for common issues. Skilled in identifying common anti-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution. Salesforce Development Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Hands-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting. Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution. System Integration Extensibility Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event-driven architectures. Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay. title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Overview about Ripik.AI: 
Ripik.ai is an Accel-backed Applied AI company building computer vision and process optimization agents for the world's largest industrial enterprises across steel, cement, aluminum, chemicals, pharma, and power. Our Vision AI platform acts as an automated pair of eyes on the shop floor monitoring materials, equipment, and processes 24/7 with 95%+ accuracy, eliminating human error, and delivering measurable gains in throughput, yield, energy efficiency, and safety.
We work with marquee customers including Tata Steel, JSW, ArcelorMittal, Vedanta, Godrej & Boyce, Grasim, Holcim, and Jindal Steel, and are scaling globally across India, the Middle East, Europe, and North America. As we move into our next phase of growth, we are building the operating backbone that will take Ripik from a high-velocity scale-up to a category-defining global industrial AI company. 
 The Role: 
We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the post-sale relationship for Ripik's enterprise industrial customers — from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and expansion. You'll be the bridge between the customer's plant floor and Ripik's product and engineering teams, translating real operational needs into clear requirements, tracking adoption and health metrics, and making sure every deployment actually delivers the throughput, yield, and safety gains our customers signed up for. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Own the end-to-end post-sale relationship for a portfolio of enterprise industrial customers — onboarding, adoption, and renewal/expansion. Translate customer needs and pain points into structured requirements, working with Product and Engineering to prioritise fixes and enhancements. Track customer health metrics — engagement, adoption, churn risk and proactively act on early warning signals before they become escalations. Run structured onboarding and rollout plans for new deployments, coordinating across engineering, operations, and the customer's plant teams. Own the customer's success plan and reporting on adoption, ROI delivered, and next steps. Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve escalations quickly and protect retention. Represent the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, driving the product feedback loop. 
 Required Skills & Experience: 
 4-8 years of experience in customer success, project/program management, or account management, ideally in B2B SaaS or a similarly complex enterprise product. Proven experience managing cross-functional delivery — engineering, design, and business — using Agile methodologies. A track record of driving measurable outcomes — user engagement, adoption, churn reduction — through data-driven decision making. Comfortable translating customer needs into clear requirements and working directly with Product and Engineering teams. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to work directly with leadership as well as enterprise customer stakeholders. Openness to travel for customer site visits as required. Ability to report to the Head Office in Noida on alternate weeks for training purposes. 
 Good to have: 
 Prior experience in an industrial, manufacturing, or enterprise B2B SaaS environment. Technical fluency across web, mobile, or data stacks — helps in translating customer issues for engineering. Experience working with cross-functional strategic mandate. 
 What can you expect? 
 Direct ownership of the customer relationship for some of India's — and soon the world's — largest industrial enterprises. Ability to shape the future of manufacturing by leveraging best-in-class AI and software; we are a unique organization with niche skill set that you would also develop while working with us World class work culture, coaching and development Mentoring from highly experienced leadership from world class companies (refer to Ripik.AI website for details) International exposure 
 For more information visit below links: 
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YRuz3XxPfcE https://www.ripik.ai https://www.linkedin.com/company/ripik-ai/ 
 Location : Rajasthan, Bihar, Chattishgarh

title: BSP - Manager
description:
BSP Development - Manager Location Bangalore India Experience 12 or more years Compensation Determined based on experience 
 Who We Are Lynx delivers modular, open standards based software for high assurance, mission critical edge systems. Our products and services help customers build, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable systems for aerospace, defense, industrial, automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure applications. MOSA.ic provides a modular foundation for secure and certifiable edge systems. Lynx also delivers safety critical graphics and AI platforms, along with engineering and lifecycle services for safety and security critical deployments. Position Summary The Manager BSP Development leads the Bangalore based team responsible for board support packages and custom platform support for LynxSecure and LynxOS 178 and LynxElement products. The role combines people leadership with hands on technical direction for new board bring up, hardware integration, device driver development, and product delivery. The successful candidate will guide a team of five to six engineers, work closely with global engineering and product stakeholders, and ensure that platform support is delivered predictably across x86, ARM, and RISC V architectures. This is a development focused role; certification experience is beneficial but not required. Key Responsibilities Lead, mentor, and develop a local team of BSP engineers, including goal setting, performance management, technical coaching, and resource planning. Own the BSP delivery plan for supported customer and product platforms. Manage schedules, risks, dependencies, priorities, and quality throughout the development lifecycle. Provide technical leadership for board bring up, firmware and boot integration, low level hardware initialization, and custom device driver development. Oversee BSP and platform support for LynxSecure, including hardware resource allocation, device passthrough, interrupt and timer virtualization, virtual networking, and subject integration. Oversee BSP support for LynxOS 178 and LynxElement, including startup code, hardware abstraction, device drivers, interrupt handling, networking, storage, serial interfaces, and other board peripherals. Guide development across x86, ARM, and RISC V platforms, including U Boot, UEFI, device trees, ACPI, platform firmware, and board diagnostics as applicable. Act as the primary technical interface for global management and internal stakeholders. Translate product needs into actionable engineering plans and communicate clear status, risks, and tradeoffs. Coordinate with hardware, firmware, hypervisor, RTOS, Linux, validation, and application teams to resolve system integration issues and support customer platforms. Establish and maintain effective engineering practices for architecture reviews, code reviews, configuration management, build and test automation, documentation, and release readiness. Required Qualifications Bachelor degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. 12 or more years of experience in embedded software, BSP development, firmware, device drivers, or platform integration, including demonstrated experience leading engineering teams. Strong programming skills in C and practical experience with low level embedded software development. Strong understanding of processor architecture, memory management, interrupts, timers, DMA, cache behavior, boot flows, and hardware initialization. Hands on experience with one or more of x86, ARM, and RISC V architectures. Experience with bootloaders, U Boot, UEFI, device trees, ACPI, firmware interfaces, and hardware diagnostics. Experience developing or integrating drivers for networking, PCIe, storage, serial, USB, GPIO, and other embedded peripherals. Experience with RTOS, Linux, hypervisors, or virtualized embedded environments. Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills using tools such as JTAG, GDB, serial consoles, trace tools, and hardware or software logs. Experience with Git, code review systems, build systems, issue tracking, and continuous integration. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical issues to engineering and management stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LynxSecure, LynxOS 178, LynxElement, or comparable hypervisor and RTOS products. Experience in safety critical or mission critical embedded product development. Familiarity with DO 178C, ISO 26262, or comparable safety critical development processes. Experience with deterministic real time behavior, multicore systems, hardware resource isolation, performance optimization, or customer hardware support. Experience in aerospace, defense, industrial, automotive, medical, or other regulated embedded markets. Leadership Expectations The manager is expected to balance hands on technical leadership with people management and execution ownership. Success in this role means building a capable BSP team, enabling new platforms efficiently, resolving complex hardware and software issues, and delivering maintainable platform support that meets product commitments.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering
description:
About Vista Equity Partners Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100B in assets under management and a portfolio of 90+ software product companies worldwide, Vista accelerates growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership. In India, Vista s presence continues to expand with 45+ portfolio companies employing more than 17,000 professionals across technology, product, customer success, and operations - reinforcing India s strategic role as a hub of innovation and talent within the Vista ecosystem. Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is embedding Generative AI across its global portfolio - enabling companies to integrate intelligent, responsible AI into products, operations, and decision-making. This initiative is strengthened through portfolio-wide learning programs, leadership workshops, and AI hackathons that foster innovation, build fluency, and accelerate practical AI adoption across teams. About Amtech Amtech is a leading provider of enterprise software solutions for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems streamline order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics - empowering customers to drive efficiency, reduce costs, and improve operational performance. With a strong commitment to innovation and customer success, Amtech delivers reliable technology backed by deep industry expertise. With Vista s investment and strategic guidance, we combine the agility of a growing technology organization with the scale, stability, and career mobility of a global software ecosystem. Our Employee Value Proposition 
 
 At Amtech, our people are our greatest differentiator. We create an environment where you can: 
 
 Purpose 
 Shape the future of manufacturing and supply chain operations by delivering mission-critical enterprise software used by industry-leading organizations. 
 Growth 
 Access continuous learning, leadership development, and cross-portfolio opportunities through Vista s global network - accelerating both technical and managerial career paths. 
 Culture 
 Work in a collaborative, transparent, and people-first environment where values, accountability, and integrity guide every decision. 
 Innovation 
 Engage with cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven automation, and contribute to modernizing financial systems and operational processes across the business. Role Description Amtech is executing an all-in AWS strategy: migrating our flagship Encore ERP to a multi-account, account-per-customer AWS architecture, operating LabelTraxx as a multi-tenant SaaS platform, and retiring legacy private-cloud infrastructure over time. Platform Engineering owns the landing zone, infrastructure as code, and the golden-path tooling that product teams build on, and the reliability of everything that runs on it. The Manager, Platform Engineering (India) leads the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams: the engineers who build the AWS platform and the engineers who keep it running. You own the people, the delivery, and the day-to-day technical leadership of that group under the guidance of the VP, working alongside the Cloud Architect, who owns platform architecture. The scope spans two engineering disciplines and a direct interface to IT/IS/PE leadership and vendors. This is a player-coach role by design: leadership first, hands-on second. Leadership means hiring and building the team, developing engineers, running the operating cadence, and representing Platform Engineering within IT/IS/PE and to partner functions. Hands-on means staying close enough to the code and the incidents to make good calls, review the changes that matter most, and lead incident response in India hours. As the team matures, the balance shifts further toward leadership without leaving the technical work behind. You will work daily with the U.S.-based Senior Manager who leads Customer SRE, the Senior SRE who owns the reliability standards both SRE teams operate on, the Sr. Director of Information Security, and the VP. This role is the first people-leadership position in Platform Engineering India. SCOPE AUTHORITY Leads hiring for the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams in partnership with Talent Acquisition; offers follow Amtechs approval process. The role leads interviews and makes the hiring recommendation for each open India position. Owns performance, leveling, and development decisions for direct reports within Amtechs leveling framework. Sets sprint priorities and capacity allocation for the India teams within the Platform Engineering roadmap. Holds incident command for platform incidents in India hours. Runs the architecture review and holds the team to its outcomes; the Cloud Architect approves architecture decisions, and decisions affecting security controls require Information Security sign-off. Leads technical evaluation of platform vendors and tooling with the Cloud Architect; recommends spend and contract changes to the VP, who holds approval. Participates in the IT/IS/PE leadership team as needed; Platform Engineerings representative in India site leadership forums. JOB DESCRIPTION People Leadership Lead, hire, and develop the India Cloud and Platform SRE teams, a team that is growing through 2027 with hosted customer count and product engineering headcount and that this role hires into from day one. Own performance management, career development, and leveling under Amtechs leveling framework; grow senior engineers into technical leads and future managers. Set the operating cadence for the India teams: sprint ceremonies, on-call rotations, triage duty, and the follow-the-sun handoff with the U.S. Build a team culture of ownership, blameless postmortems, and written decision-making that holds across time zones. Give engineers credit publicly and feedback privately. Architecture Technical Strategy Deliver the AWS platform roadmap set with the Cloud Architect, who owns architecture: multi-account organization, landing zone, networking, identity, and the account-per-customer Encore tenancy model. Plan and deliver Encore-on-AWS environment builds (temporary, production, demo) on the shared golden IaC stack, and LabelTraxx platform work, against the roadmap. Run the architecture review: decisions are recorded as ADRs, reviewed with the Senior SRE, and approved by the Cloud Architect. Make sure decisions are made on time and carried through by the team. Evaluate and integrate emerging capabilities, including AI-assisted and agentic engineering tooling, within Amtechs AI governance guardrails. Platform Engineering Delivery Hold the technical bar for infrastructure code: enforce module standards set with the Cloud Architect, review the highest-blast-radius changes, and write code where it unblocks the team. Operate and enforce standards for CI/CD (GitHub Actions), progressive delivery, environment promotion, and secrets management. Drive automation of environment provisioning so a new hosted customer is a pipeline run, not a project; publish and hit onboarding time targets. Own delivery against the Platform Engineering roadmap: sprint commitments, capacity budgets (strategic versus tactical), and the response commitments made to requesters. Reliability Operations Own delivery of production reliability for the shared platform in India hours, operating on the SLO frameworks, observability architecture (OpenTelemetry, OpenObserve, CloudWatch), and PagerDuty service models set by the Senior SRE. Hold authority to deviate from a reliability standard during an active incident, restore the standard when the incident closes, and raise a postmortem item to ratify or revert the change. Propose standard changes to the Senior SRE, who decides; the VP arbitrates. Lead major incident response for platform incidents in India hours; own postmortems and the remediation backlog. Own patching, backup and restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and capacity management on a published calendar. Extend observability to AI workloads so usage, performance, and spend are visible in the same plane as compute. Security, Compliance Cost Implement and enforce security architecture with Information Security and the Cloud Architect: IAM boundaries, network segmentation, encryption, and data governance for customer data. Ensure the platform satisfies SOC 2 and ISO 27001 obligations by design, with audit evidence generated through automation. Drive FinOps outcomes with Finance: tagging governance, right-sizing, Savings Plans coverage, unit cost visibility, and input to the AWS enterprise commit. Surface technical and delivery risk to the VP early: sequencing, vendor dependencies, and single points of failure. AI Competency Adopt agentic and AI-assisted engineering workflows for the team within the autonomy tiers, guardrails, and auditability set by Platform Engineering; measure productivity against baselines. Apply the validation layers (schema, rules, model-graded, human review) appropriate to each change by blast radius. Prevent AI-generated code from degrading platform quality at fleet scale: evaluation harnesses, complexity metrics, and AI-attributed defect tracking. Mentor engineers in safe, high-leverage AI usage; enforce data classification policy in all AI-assisted work. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner with the Customer SRE leader so the platform the India team builds and the environments Customer SRE runs evolve together. Partner with the Senior SRE on reliability standards: implement and enforce them in India and feed operational learning back. Serve as senior technical counterpart to AWS, consulting partners, and third-party providers on funded programs in India hours. Report team delivery, reliability, and risk clearly to IT/IS/PE leadership; support integration work for acquisitions. Ensure knowledge is durable: documentation, runbooks, and deliberate succession planning so no platform capability depends on one person, including you WORKING HOURS Core hours are India business hours. The role carries a scheduled overlap window with U.S. leadership for architecture reviews and leadership syncs, set in the team operating cadence. Incident command applies in India hours; weekend paging is P0 only and rotates across the team rather than resting on this role. QUALIFICATIONS Must have Hands-on AWS platform experience in a multi-account environment: landing zones, account vending, IAM, and networking, at a level that lets you review your teams work credibly. Strong Terraform and IaC experience: working in a shared module ecosystem with testing and versioning discipline. 2+ years leading engineers as a people manager with direct responsibility for hiring, performance, and development, within 12+ years of progressive engineering experience. Experience leading production operations under SLOs: on-call design, incident command, postmortems, and observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent. Strongly preferred Designed AI-assisted or agentic engineering systems with guardrails, autonomy tiers, and measured ROI; L4+ AI competency by industry frameworks. Strong software engineering foundation (Python, Go, or similar) and fluency with modern CI/CD (GitHub Actions or equivalent). Working command of cloud security architecture and compliance-driven design (SOC 2, ISO 27001). Preferred Track record of building and retaining a high-performing engineering team in a distributed, multi-time-zone organization. Communicates decisions in writing clearly enough that executives act on them and engineers execute them without a meeting. Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated skills. AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional. Experience with multi-tenant SaaS and account-per-customer tenancy economics. title: Airbnb Support Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION AIRBNB SUPPORT SPECIALIST Location 
 Bengaluru, Karnataka Department 
 Operations / Guest Experience Employment Type 
 Full-Time Reports To 
 Operations Manager / Revenue Manager 

 1. About ANI Living Spaces 
 ANI Living Spaces is a professionally managed service apartment and living-space company providing comfortable and reliable accommodation for short-term, medium-term, and long-term guests. 

 2. Job Summary 
 The Airbnb Support Specialist will be responsible for managing Airbnb guest communication, reservations, listing information, guest requests, reviews, cancellations, and platform-related issues. The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, excellent follow-up abilities, good knowledge of Airbnb operations, and the ability to coordinate effectively with housekeeping, maintenance, reservations, and property-management teams. 

 3. Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain ANI Living Spaces Airbnb listings. Ensure listing descriptions, photographs, amenities, house rules, check-in instructions, and property information are accurate and up to date. Monitor listing quality and guest feedback and identify opportunities to improve listing presentation. Respond promptly and professionally to Airbnb guest enquiries and messages. Handle pre-booking questions regarding availability, pricing, facilities, location, check-in, and house rules. Send check-in, check-out, and stay-related information to guests. Monitor new reservations and handle booking modifications, extensions, cancellations, and date changes. Ensure availability information is accurate and synchronized with other booking channels where applicable. Handle guest complaints and service requests received through Airbnb. Coordinate with housekeeping and maintenance teams to resolve issues quickly. Monitor Airbnb reviews and ratings and respond professionally according to company guidelines. Monitor competitor listings and market pricing and coordinate pricing changes with the Revenue/Operations Manager. Monitor occupancy, booking patterns, cancellations, and demand. Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, front office, and operations teams. Maintain proper records of pending and completed guest requests. 

 4. Daily Responsibilities Monitor Airbnb messages and enquiries. Respond to guests within the company's defined response-time target. Check new bookings, cancellations, and booking modifications. Review upcoming arrivals and departures. Coordinate property readiness with the operations team. Follow up on open guest complaints. Monitor reviews and ratings. Update booking and guest information in the relevant systems. Prepare daily/weekly Airbnb performance reports. 

 5. Required Skills Excellent written and verbal English communication. Strong customer-service and interpersonal skills. Good knowledge of Airbnb and online travel platforms. Strong problem-solving and follow-up abilities. Good computer skills. Knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets, WhatsApp, email, and property-management systems. Ability to multitask and manage multiple guest conversations simultaneously. Ability to remain calm and professional when handling complaints. Good attention to detail. Knowledge of Kannada and/or Hindi will be an advantage. 

 6. Qualification & Experience Graduate or equivalent qualification. 1–3 years of experience in Airbnb management, hotel reservations, hospitality, service apartments, OTA management, customer support, or property management. Experience managing Airbnb, Booking.com, or other OTA platforms will be an advantage. Freshers with excellent communication skills and strong interest in hospitality/OTA operations may also be considered. 

 7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Airbnb response time and guest response rate. Booking conversion/support effectiveness. Guest satisfaction and ratings. Complaint resolution time. Cancellation rate. Accuracy of reservation information. Review response rate. Listing quality and accuracy. Coordination with operations teams. Revenue and occupancy support. Number of unresolved guest issues. 

 8. Working Hours Full-time position. Shift-based working may be required depending on business requirements. Weekend and public-holiday availability may be required. Urgent guest communications may occasionally need to be handled outside regular working hours as per company policy. 

 9. Ideal Candidate Customer-focused, highly responsive, polite, and professional. Organized and detail-oriented. Comfortable communicating with international and domestic guests. Good at handling complaints. Strong in follow-up and coordination. Comfortable working in a fast-paced hospitality environment. Willing to take ownership of guest issues from start to resolution. 

 10. Additional Benefits Performance incentives Lunch Facility Health Insurance OTA/booking performance incentives, where applicable Attendance incentives Employee benefits as per company policy Training and development Career growth opportunities

Key Skills: Upsell,Customer Engagement,Client Success,Engagement,Client

title: Sr Customer Experience Associate
description:
Role Name: Senior Customer Experience Associate 
 At Kapture CX, we are looking for a Senior Customer Experience Associate in our Customer Experience team . Who are we Kapture CX is a leading SaaS platform that helps enterprises automate and elevate customer experience through intelligent, AI-powered solutions. We partner with enterprises across industries to bring scalable automation and insight-driven efficiencies to their CX operations. Over a thousand clients across 18 countries have used Kapture s products to enhance their customer experience, including Unilever, Reliance, Coca-Cola, Bigbasket, Meesho, Airtel Payments Bank and Cathay Pacific. Kapture delivers industry-specific solutions powered by AI, tailored workflows, and seamless automation. Kapture CX is headquartered in Bangalore and we have offices in Mumbai and Delhi/NCR in India, in addition to offices in the USA, UAE, Singapore, Philippines and Indonesia. 
 What is this role all about This role is all about owning and being the first line of technical problem-solving for our customers, ensuring their queries, issues and service requests are resolved quickly and effectively. You ll work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, manage tickets, and deliver a seamless customer experience on our SaaS platform. 
 Sounds interesting Here s a more detailed description of what you will do in this role: You will monitor and manage customer support tickets, ensuring quick first responses and resolution within defined SLAs. You will investigate and troubleshoot technical issues, raise BUGs/CRs on JIRA, and proactively follow up to drive them to closure. You will collaborate closely with Implementation, Product, SRE and Engineering teams, sharing complete and accurate details to enable faster debugging. You will build a strong understanding of client workflows, business logic, and use cases to provide effective and context-aware support. You will develop documentation and runbooks for client workflows, business context, usecases, FAQs, troubleshooting guides and so on. 
 You will take complete ownership of customer issues, tracking priorities, escalating critical cases, and ensuring a smooth end-to-end resolution experience. This is a Bangalore -based role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility. 
 What does success look like in this role Success in this role means consistently delivering fast, high-quality resolutions to customer issues, meeting SLAs, and earning customer trust while proactively collaborating with internal teams to keep our platform running smoothly. 
 What would make you a good fit for this role Here are the basic requirements: You have 3+ years of experience in a Senior Customer Experience or helpdesk role, handling customer queries on SaaS or CRM platforms. You are comfortable working with ticketing tools and can manage multiple tickets while meeting SLAs. You communicate clearly and professionally, both in writing and over calls, with customers and internal teams. You take ownership of issues and follow them through until complete resolution You will create and maintain documentation-runbooks, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides 
 What are the most critical skills for this role You have strong debugging and problem-solving skills to identify root causes of technical issues. You can analyse issues logically and document them clearly for escalation to SRE, Product or engineering teams. You are customer-focused and know how to balance empathy with technical accuracy. You have worked with APIs, integrations, or basic backend troubleshooting. You manage time and priorities effectively in a fast-paced support environment 
 You will have an advantage if you: You have hands-on experience with JIRA for BUG/CR tracking and escalation management. You hold any technical certification related to IT, support, or systems. You have previously supported enterprise or high-volume customer environments 
 Why should you be interested Here s what you will gain from this role: You will work on a leading enterprise SaaS platform used by some of India s top brands, gaining real-world exposure to large-scale customer operations. You will develop strong technical and problem-solving skills by handling diverse, real-time support challenges. You will collaborate closely with experienced engineering and customer success teams, accelerating your professional growth. You will be part of a fast-growing organization that values ownership, learning, and career progression

The Software Configuration Engineering Senior Analyst will work closely with various departments, including development, quality assurance, and client support teams, to ensure a smooth upgrade process and effective issue resolution. title: Customer Success Manager - Field Operations
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for a Customer Success Manager / Project Manager to own partner projects end to end from launching a pilot and building the operational funnel to scaling successful projects across cities. This is a hands-on operations + partner management + project management role. You will work closely with platform partners, women candidates, field teams, vehicle/EV partners and internal teams to deliver measurable project outcomes. 
 The role requires someone who is comfortable working in the field, building processes from scratch and taking complete ownership of project outcomes. 
 About Aatm Nirbhar 
 Aatm Nirbhar is a women-led social enterprise helping women move safely and earn independently through skilling, mobility enablement and livelihood opportunities. We operate a network of women trainers across 19 cities and work with partners including Urban Company, Swiggy, Yes Madam and L&T Finance to train and enable women partners and riders. We are a profitable, for-profit company building solutions in the mobility and livelihood space. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Project & Operations Management Own partner projects from launch through execution and scale. Build and manage operational processes for new projects and cities. Track project performance, identify bottlenecks and drive corrective action. Ensure projects are delivered within agreed timelines and targets. 2. Lead Generation & Candidate Conversion Drive lead generation through digital campaigns, community networks, catchment-area activities, partner referrals and field mobilisation. Build and manage local recruitment channels and networks. Qualify and counsel women interested in delivery and mobility-based livelihood opportunities. Work with candidates and, where required, their families to address concerns and enable conversion. 3. Training & Rider Onboarding Coordinate training delivery and ensure candidates complete training. Manage onboarding onto partner platforms/apps. Coordinate with vehicle dealers, OEMs, EV rental providers and lending partners to facilitate vehicle access. Track rider activation, adoption and retention after onboarding. 4. Partner / Client Management Own day-to-day relationships with partner stakeholders. Understand partner requirements and translate them into operational execution. Build strong working relationships with city/regional leadership and project stakeholders. Identify opportunities to improve project performance and expand the partnership. 5. Team Management Hire, train and manage field recruiters and tele-callers as project volume grows. Set targets, monitor performance and ensure team productivity. Build local teams and operational networks for new cities. 6. Project Scale & Expansion Replicate successful pilot models across new cities. Launch and stabilise operations in new markets. Monitor performance of established markets and protect existing revenue. Identify opportunities for revenue growth and expansion within existing partnerships. Key Success Metrics Performance will be measured against clear business and operational outcomes, including: Training completion Rider / vehicle adoption Rider activation and retention Project delivery within timelines Partner satisfaction and engagement New partner/project launches Revenue protection and revenue growth Successful launch and stabilisation of new cities Field team productivity and performance 
 What Were Looking For 
 Experience 48 years of experience in gig economy operations, last-mile logistics, delivery operations, field operations, workforce management, partner operations or customer success . Experience managing rider, driver, delivery partner or service-partner supply is highly relevant. Hands-on experience managing field teams, catchment areas or local recruitment networks. Experience working with external clients, platform partners or business stakeholders. 
 Skills & Capabilities Strong project management and execution skills. Ability to build processes and systems from scratch. Strong stakeholder and partner management skills. Comfortable working with data, dashboards and operational metrics. Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously. Willingness to travel and work closely with field teams. 
 Youll Do Well Here If You Are comfortable operating in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Take ownership rather than waiting for instructions or established processes. Are comfortable spending time in the field and solving problems on the ground. Can build relationships with both senior partner stakeholders and frontline teams. Are driven by measurable outcomes and business impact. Can build and manage teams as the project scales. 
 What This Role Is Like This is a hands-on role in a fast-growing, evolving environment. Projects may require building processes from scratch, working across multiple stakeholders and adapting quickly to changing ground realities. It is suited to someone who wants significant ownership over an outcome and enjoys solving operational problems rather than working within a fixed playbook. 
 Travel: Regular travel may be required across project locations and cities. 
 Equal Opportunity: We actively encourage women to apply. Our trainers and the majority of our team are women.

title: Sr. Commercial Relationship Manager
description:
Job Summary 
 ServiceChannel is the leading cloud-based service automation platform for facilities management. We offer a single platform to source, procure, manage and pay for repair and maintenance services from commercial contractors. We are committed to creating a great product for our customers and a great work environment for our employees to succeed professionally and personally. ServiceChannel is seeking a Senior Commercial Relationship Manager (Team Lead) to join our India Delivery Center (IDC) in Bangalore. This is a customer-facing, quota-bearing role that combines ownership of a portfolio of higher-value SMB / Small Commercial accounts with a player-coach responsibility to improve execution consistency across the IDC commercial team. The Senior RM partners closely with U.S.-based leadership to drive forecasting rigor, escalation handling, and operational excellence across the scaled coverage model. This role will support our Global customer base with primary account ownership across United States (majority) and Europe (minority). The roles will scale to align to U.S. and Europe business hours; working with customers across all U.S. and European time zones. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and execute the end-to-end renewal and upsell process across an assigned portfolio, including proactive outreach, renewal planning, pricing execution, contract progression, and negotiations. Own expansion outcomes for the portfolio by identifying, qualifying, and executing upsell and cross-sell opportunities using structured commercial plays. Conduct customer-facing commercial conversations (renewals, pricing discussions, negotiations, and expansion conversations) with professionalism and strong business acumen. Act as a player-coach for the IDC commercial team: provide targeted deal support, coaching, and best-practice guidance on renewals and expansion execution. Serve as the first point of escalation for complex customer scenarios, commercial exceptions, or cross-functional blockers; coordinate resolution with Support, Billing / Collections, Implementation / Professional Services, Product, and U.S. Account Management leadership. Maintain high-quality account and opportunity data in Salesforce, Gainsight, and related tools to ensure forecasting accuracy, visibility, and continuity across teams. Ensure consistent execution of playbooks, standard work, and segmentation rules across the IDC team; identify bottlenecks and opportunities to improve cycle time and customer experience. Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to align commercial priorities with adoption and customer health signals; support (but do not own) EBR preparation and follow-up by providing commercial context and action plans. Partner with Sales Enablement and U.S. leadership to provide feedback on playbooks and enablement needs based on real-world execution. Participate in staggered-shift coverage aligned to U.S. and European time zones, including overlap into U.S. Pacific Time mornings (targeting availability through ~12:00 PM Pacific) to support live customer engagement and escalations. 
 
 Required Skills Experience 
 7+ years experience in a customer-facing commercial role (Account Management, Relationship Management, Renewals, Inside Sales, or Customer Success with commercial ownership), preferably in a SaaS environment. Demonstrated success owning complex renewals and negotiations and consistently delivering against quota. Proven ability to drive expansion outcomes (upsell / cross-sell) and to influence deal strategy. Exceptional spoken and written English communication skills and strong customer presence with U.S.-based customers. Demonstrated ability to coach peers and lead through influence (player-coach mindset) without formal people-management authority. Strong business management discipline: forecasting rigor, prioritization, and the ability to synthesize insights for leadership. Proficiency with CRM and customer systems (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight) and a track record of data hygiene and operational excellence. Ability to collaborate cross-functionally, remove blockers, and drive outcomes in a complex environment. 
 
 Preferred Skills Experience 
 Experience supporting scaled customer coverage models and/or working with offshore/distributed teams. Experience leading operational initiatives (process improvement, Kaizen, standard work) that improve commercial execution. Experience in Facility Management and/or relevant verticals (Retail, Restaurants, Grocery, etc.).

title: Student Relationship Manager
description:
Job Title: Student Relationship Manager 
 Entry-Level | Individual Contributor | Campus-Based 
 About the Role 
 We're hiring a Student Relationship Manager to be the single, non-academic point of contact for a mapped cohort of around 180 students on campus. This is an entry-level, high-visibility role for someone calm under pressure who genuinely enjoys helping people and owns a problem until it's actually closed not just logged. You'll be the first person students turn to for anything outside the classroom: hostel, mess, transport, fees, documentation, campus facilities, or simply needing to be heard. 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 0–1 years of experience — freshers are encouraged to apply Any graduate (bachelor's degree), any academic stream Excellent verbal and written communication skills Natural empathy and active listening — able to hear someone out fully without rushing to judgment or a canned response Calm and steady under pressure Proactive and self-starting — follows up and closes loops without needing to be chased Comfortable with basic tracker/spreadsheet discipline and a weekly reporting rhythm Willing to be based on campus full-time and work the academic calendar — this is not a remote or hybrid role 
 Good to Have 
 Prior experience in a people-facing or service role — even part-time, an internship, or volunteering Familiarity with student life, hostels, or a residential campus environment 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Be the single point of contact every mapped student knows to go to for any non-academic issue Log, categorize, and route issues to the right owner (facilities, warden, finance, transport) with an SLA, and track to closure Run a standing cadence of check-ins to catch disengagement, attendance drops, or dissatisfaction early Own the NPS of the mapped cohort — run the feedback loop and act on what's driving detractor scores Liaise with campus administration and facility vendors on recurring issues Maintain a live issue tracker and share a weekly dashboard with Program Ops 
 Ideal Backgrounds Psychology, social work, HR, or hospitality management graduates; BPO/voice and chat customer service freshers; hospitality and aviation entry-role candidates (front office, guest relations, cabin crew trainees); campus placement candidates with strong extracurricular signals (NSS, student council, peer counselling); ed-tech/ed-services customer success or student-counselling freshers. Growth Path Strong performers with consistent NPS ownership and tracker discipline are the natural pipeline into the Student Relationship Senior Manager role as regions expand.

description:
Job Overview: Responsible for general maintenance and any required archival of documents produced by the CPS Project Management (PM) Team. Organizing, gathering, scanning, and filing of all applicable documents into appropriate electronic and/or paper copy locations, including the Trial Master File (TMF), as directed by Fortrea SOPs or other applicable directive. Responsible for filing TMF documents for CPS PM, Non-Fortrea sites, and the Fortrea P1MS Clinical Monitoring Team. Responsible for document query generation and file reconciliation/resolution activities to support delivery of the TMF to client quality and integrity specifications, as well as to meet project timelines and productivity targets. Summary of Responsibilities: Proactively maintains an internal standardized filing structure for study-related documents, as well as departmental files, which may include non-project-specific sponsor files. Creates and/or maintains any general document/file-related tracking forms and/or spreadsheets, as applicable. Gathers, organizes, scans, and ships project documentation, as required. Assists in the review and finalization of the TMF Plan and Index for individual projects. May assist the PC/PM in project setup activities around TMF (e.g., TMF account request, TMF Specialist request, etc.), as well as TMF closeout processes. Takes ownership for maintaining the TMF (Fortrea /Client systems) by working with applicable project team members to retrieve, file, and upload documents in accordance with applicable project milestones/timelines, SOPs, policies, system, and client requirements. Interacts directly with project teams in securing documents for the TMF, as well as for follow[1]up regarding missing documents, as appropriate; actively monitors and performs document quality checks, identifying, tracking, and following up on document quality issues with relevant staff members. Works with the PM/PC involved project teams, and applicable business partners for reconciliation of the TMF as part of the quality control process. May generate copies of project data and other project information on various electronic media for archival and/or to provide to the PM or PC for client delivery. Leads and performs archiving duties for paper and/or electronic media, as needed. May provide departmental management teams with metric data within areas of expertise, as needed, to show compliance with applicable processes; performs other departmental or project administrative tasks, as assigned. Trains and mentors new Document Specialists in all aspects of the role; responsible for routine development/review/revision of DS training materials. TMF Subject Matter Expert; trains new document specialists and other team members in the use of various eTMF systems/processes, as needed. All other duties as needed or assigned. Qualifications (Minimum Required): High School Diploma or equivalent at minimum. BS or equivalent in scientific field preferred. Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements. Language Skills Required: Speaking: English Writing/Reading: English Experience (Minimum Required): Strong written and verbal communication skills (English language). Experience working with computers and basic programs (i.e., Adobe Acrobat, Word, Excel, Power Point). Strong organizational skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced setting with many interruptions. Physical Demands/Work Environment: Must be able to sit at a computer for long periods of time. Must be able to use hands to finger, handle or touch objects, tools, or controls, including a computer keyboard, for up to 8 hours per day. Standard office and/or home working environment.  to resolving customer grievances and escalations, the team manages every interaction 
 with empathy and efficiency. Using channels like chat, calls, and email, we aim for rapid 
 resolution, high CSAT scores, and continuous process improvement-leveraging 
 automation and data insights to scale service quality as we grow. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Executive to manage customer 
 interactions across calls, emails, and chats. You will be the first point of contact for Navi 
 customers, responsible for delivering accurate, empathetic, and timely support. The role 
 requires strong communication skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to ensuring 
 high levels of customer satisfaction across all touchpoints. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
 
 Handle customer queries through inbound/outbound calls, emails, and live chat. 
 Provide clear, accurate information about our products and services. 
 Troubleshoot common issues, provide first-level resolutions, and escalate 
 complex cases as needed. 
 
 Handle escalations and make timely escalation callbacks to ensure issue 
 closure. 
 
 
 
 
 Ensure compliance with company policies during all customer interactions. 
 Maintain accurate documentation of customer communications. 
 Remain flexible to support different channels based on business needs. 
 Flexibility to work rotational shifts, including weekends, holidays, and extended hours during 
 peak periods. 
 
 
 
 Must Haves 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Fluency in English and Hindi, with excellent written English communication skills. 
 Strong typing speed and accuracy. 
 Bachelors degree or equivalent diploma in any discipline. 
 Ability to manage customer interactions across calls, emails, and chat channels. 
 13 years of experience in customer support or similar roles. 
 Customer-first mindset with strong problem-solving skills. 
 High attention to detail and a commitment to delivering quality service. 
 Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate clearly and empathetically. 
 A collaborative and proactive team player with a strong sense of ownership. 
 Preferred tools: CRM platforms like Freshdesk or Zendesk, and Google Sheets 
 for tracking and reporting. 
 About Navi 
 We are on a mission to make finance simple, accessible and affordable for a billion 
 Indians. Guided by a strong customer-first approach, we are building tech-first solutions 
 that work at scale. Our offerings include a range of financial products and services 
 across Loans, Insurance, Mutual Funds, Digital Gold and UPI. 
 Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of Indias 
 fastest-growing financial services organisations. But were just getting started! 
 Our Culture 
 At Navi, were a place where ambition meets opportunity and ideas turn into impact 
 quickly. We empower people with high ownership from the start, encouraging them to 
 solve meaningful problems and build with excellence. Teams here work in an 
 environment that values speed, collaboration and craftsmanship, while celebrating 
 learning, growth and shared wins along the way. Whether youre shaping the future of 
 fintech products or driving innovation behind the scenes, life at Navi means being part 
 of a high-energy, talent-driven workplace where your contributions truly make a 
 difference. 
 
 
 
 Were guided by our own operating system - The Navi OS - a set of principles that 
 shape how we work and win together. You can explore them at navi.com/our-values 
 to see what drives us every day. 
 If this feels like you, Navi is the place to grow, thrive and make a real impact.

title: Customer Relationship Manager
description:
ROLE OVERVIEW As a Customer Relationship Manager (CRM) at Lenskart, you will be the face of the store the first person a customer meets and the last impression they carry. You will own the end-to-end in-store experience, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed, heard, and valued. Beyond warm hospitality, you will play a critical role in resolving escalations, managing difficult situations with grace, and turning dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Customer Greeting & Experience Management Welcome every customer entering the store with warmth and professionalism, setting a positive first impression from the door. Understand customer needs proactively and guide them to the right product, service, or associate within the store. Acknowledge and manage wait times; keep customers engaged and comfortable during peak hours. Coordinate seamless handoffs between optometrists, sales associates, and the CRM desk. Grievance Resolution & Customer Recovery Own all in-store customer complaints from product defects and service delays to prescription concerns. Resolve grievances at the store level within defined TATs; escalate with full context when required. Maintain a complaint log and follow up post-resolution to confirm customer satisfaction. Identify recurring complaint patterns and flag them to store leadership and the operations team. Difficult Customer Handling Manage irate or highly dissatisfied customers with empathy, patience, and solution orientation. De-escalate tense situations through active listening and calm, composed communication. Exercise judgment on goodwill gestures (replacement, priority service, escalation) within authorized limits. Store Experience & CRM Operations Maintain store ambience, queue management, and signage in the customer-facing zone. Capture customer feedback (NPS, in-store forms) and share weekly insights with the store team. Track daily footfall, walk-in-to-conversion ratios, and complaint resolution metrics. Coordinate with the post-sales and fulfilment team for order status updates and delivery queries. 
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Must-Have 1–4 years of experience in customer-facing roles — hospitality (hotel front desk, concierge), premium retail, airport lounge, or mall guest services. Demonstrated ability to handle difficult, unhappy, or demanding customers with composure and empathy. Fluency in Kannada and English; Hindi is a strong advantage. Warm, approachable personality with a solution-first and ownership mindset. Graduate in any discipline. 
 Good to Have Background from premium malls (UB City, Phoenix, Palladium), 5-star hotel front desks (Taj, Oberoi, Leela), or airport lounges (Encalm, Plaza Premium). Familiarity with CRM tools, complaint ticketing systems, or basic store management software. Prior exposure to eyewear, healthcare retail, or regulated product categories. Comfort with basic data entry — logging complaints, updating resolution status, sharing daily reports. 
 CORE COMPETENCIES Customer Empathy Acknowledges emotions before jumping to solutions; makes every customer feel heard and respected. Conflict De-escalation Stays calm under pressure; reframes complaints into resolvable problems without getting defensive. Service Ownership Does not pass the buck; sees every complaint through to closure personally. Communication Clear, polite, and confident in both Kannada and English; adapts tone to the customer. Attention to Detail Notices potential service gaps proactively and addresses them before they escalate. Adaptability Maintains service quality consistently across high-footfall peak hours and quieter periods.

description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.


By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.


Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**What will you do:**


The CCaaS Platinum Support Account Manager is the main technical support contact serving Sprinklr’s largest and most complex customers. We work with program managers and executive level decision makers at large enterprise brands to deliver excellent customer support experience. Platinum Support also acts as an internal escalation point, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success \& Services to resolve issues. The PSAM also acts as the day\-to\-day internal escalation point, and point of contact for clients, ensuring optimal client service as it relates to platform performance, functionality, enhancements, and configuration while supporting line management and operational excellence.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the technical voice of the customer and advocate for your clients’ needs when escalating product issues.
* Be an expert on the Client’s custom implementation and be able to resolve issues pertaining to their setup that doesn’t require engineering intervention
* Meet regularly with your customer contacts for Case Reviews. You’ll cover trends you see in support tickets, look for opportunities to reduce pain points in product use, and deliver updates on outstanding issues.
* Collaborate regularly with other members of the account team to address reported issues and support their efforts.
* Attend bridge calls for escalated issues and work directly with the customer and engineering for expedited resolution.
* Plan and execute important events for customers in collaboration with success/MS team
* Prepare regular reports for internal stakeholders for all your accounts to highlight customer health index and plat of action to improve.
* Share regular insights into new product features with customer
* Discuss and plan release readiness with customer to meet customer expectations and ensure faster resolution on release related issues.
* Closely monitor TTR for all support cases from your accounts and always ensure adherence to SLA.
* Roll up your sleeve and work with support/engineering teams to debug critical issues reported by your accounts.
* Ensure the highest standard of service delivery to our platinum customers.
* Expertise in business analysis, functional specification, system design, platform configuration, testing, and training while assisting in operational housekeeping. This includes:
* Provide social insights and recommendations to support clients’ business practices
* Design and configure the appropriate Sprinklr solution to meet all requirements based on best practices and client’s custom needs, adhering to primary business use cases and platform functionalities
* Perform health checks of existing customers in need of platform upgrades and suggest solutions based on best practices and client needs.
* Provide consulting advise to clients about Sprinklr platform during different phases of project implementation

**What makes you qualified?**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Fluent in English
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
* A drive to dig into the details of a system or process to solve customer problems.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills.
* Self\-motivated, takes initiative, assumes ownership.
* Ability to work in a highly collaborative and fast\-paced environment.
* Graduation from Tier\-1 College.
* Strong customer handling skills and willingness to serve customers across various time zones. This role will be predominantly to support our U.S based customers so the candidate is expected to support U.S time zones. Occasionally work on weekends may be required as per business needs.
